sources.TheHollowChoir: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original, square, four-quadrant civilization art master for a strategy-game mod called The Hollow Choir. Each quadrant is independent painted art from the same civilization: upper left a dignified, androgynous adult leader called The First Note, pale violet eyes and ornate resonant crystalline collar, head and shoulders facing the viewer, head centered within that quadrant with generous space around it; upper right an armored Chorus Sentinel, blackened steel and luminous amethyst, guard depicted waist-up, centered and with ample clearance around the face and silhouette; lower left a grand Resonance Hall, a hall of vaulted basalt and clustered purple organ-pipe crystals, centered 3/4 exterior view, readable silhouette; lower right a wide-view underground capital called Resonance built among stalactites and immense purple crystals, distinct city skyline and torch-lit bridges. Each painting fills its entire quadrant and keeps key details away from the quadrant edge. Do not duplicate any subject across quadrants. No text, labels, frame, watermark, or simulated game UI.
